resources.title: LangChain Documentation
resources.description: Comprehensive framework for building applications with LLMs. Includes chains, agents, memory, and integrations with major AI providers. Great for both beginners and advanced developers.
resources.localRelevance: Used in Hawaii AI Hackathon projects

resources.title: Anthropic Claude API
resources.description: Access Claude's advanced reasoning capabilities through a simple API. Supports long context windows (200k tokens), function calling, and vision. Excellent documentation and examples.

resources.title: Fast.ai Practical Deep Learning Course
resources.description: Free course teaching deep learning from a practical, code-first approach. No prerequisites needed - starts from basics and builds to state-of-the-art. Includes notebooks and community forum.

resources.title: Hugging Face Transformers
resources.description: State-of-the-art machine learning library for PyTorch, TensorFlow, and JAX. Over 150,000 pretrained models for NLP, vision, audio, and multimodal tasks. Active community and excellent docs.

resources.title: Attention Is All You Need (Paper)
resources.description: The foundational paper introducing the Transformer architecture that revolutionized NLP and AI. Essential reading for understanding modern LLMs like GPT and Claude.
resources.localRelevance: Discussed in Hawaii AI reading group

resources.title: Cursor AI Code Editor
resources.description: AI-first code editor built on VS Code. Features include AI chat, code generation, multi-file editing, and codebase understanding. Great for vibe coding and rapid prototyping.

resources.title: Kaggle - Learn AI & ML
resources.description: Free micro-courses on Python, ML, deep learning, and data science. Includes interactive coding exercises and certificates. Great for hands-on learning with real datasets.

resources.title: Ollama - Run LLMs Locally
resources.description: Get up and running with large language models on your own machine. Supports Llama 3, Mistral, Gemma, and many others. Simple command-line interface and REST API.

resources.title: 3Blue1Brown - Neural Networks
resources.description: Beautiful animated video series explaining how neural networks work from first principles. Perfect for visual learners. No heavy math background required.
resources.localRelevance: Great for Hawaii high school AI workshops

resources.title: Pinecone Vector Database
resources.description: Managed vector database for building AI applications with semantic search and RAG. Simple API, scales automatically, and integrates with LangChain, LlamaIndex, and major frameworks.

resources.title: Stanford CS229: Machine Learning
resources.description: Andrew Ng's classic machine learning course. Covers supervised learning, unsupervised learning, and best practices. Lecture videos, notes, and assignments available free online.

resources.title: Vercel AI SDK
resources.description: Open-source toolkit for building AI-powered apps with React, Next.js, Vue, and Svelte. Handles streaming, function calling, and chat UI components. Excellent DX.
resources.localRelevance: Used in local web dev projects

resources.title: Papers With Code
resources.description: Free resource with ML papers, code implementations, and datasets. Browse by task (image classification, NLP, etc.) or by dataset. Benchmarks track state-of-the-art results.
resources.localRelevance: Used in Hawaii AI journal club

resources.title: Replicate - Run AI Models in the Cloud
resources.description: Run open-source machine learning models with a simple API. Pay only for what you use. Great for experimenting with Stable Diffusion, Llama, Whisper, and hundreds of other models.

resources.title: Prompt Engineering Guide
resources.description: Comprehensive guide to prompt engineering techniques. Covers zero-shot, few-shot, chain-of-thought, and advanced methods. Includes examples for Claude, GPT, and other models.

resources.title: Common Crawl Dataset
resources.description: Massive web crawl dataset updated monthly. Contains petabytes of data used to train many LLMs. Accessible via S3 or API. Essential for understanding training data sources.

resources.title: OpenAI Cookbook
resources.description: Example code and guides for building with OpenAI models. Covers embeddings, fine-tuning, function calling, and more. All examples include working code you can adapt.

resources.title: AI Alignment Forum
resources.description: Discussion forum for researchers working on AI safety and alignment. Technical posts on value learning, corrigibility, interpretability, and other alignment topics.
resources.localRelevance: Hawaii AI safety interest group follows this

resources.title: Weights & Biases - Experiment Tracking
resources.description: Platform for tracking ML experiments, visualizing results, and collaborating with teams. Free for individuals and academics. Integrates with PyTorch, TensorFlow, and major frameworks.

resources.title: The Illustrated Transformer
resources.description: Visual explanation of the Transformer architecture with animated diagrams. Breaks down attention, positional encoding, and training. Makes complex concepts intuitive.
resources.localRelevance: Used in UH Hawaii AI study group

resources.title: LlamaIndex (formerly GPT Index)
resources.description: Framework for connecting LLMs to external data sources. Simplifies building RAG applications with document loaders, vector stores, and query engines. Python and TypeScript support.

resources.title: Hugging Face Datasets
resources.description: Hub with 100,000+ datasets for ML. One-line loading, preprocessing tools, and streaming for large datasets. Covers NLP, vision, audio, and multimodal tasks.

resources.title: Anthropic's Constitutional AI Paper
resources.description: Research on training AI systems to be helpful, harmless, and honest using AI feedback. Foundational work behind Claude's alignment approach. Includes methodology and results.

resources.title: Midjourney AI Art Generator
resources.description: Text-to-image AI accessed through Discord. Creates stunning artwork from text descriptions. Great for concept art, ideation, and creative projects. Community of millions.
resources.localRelevance: Used by local artists and designers

resources.title: Hawaii AI Meetup Group
resources.description: Monthly meetups for AI enthusiasts in Honolulu. Talks, workshops, and networking. Topics range from beginner tutorials to cutting-edge research. Everyone welcome!
resources.localRelevance: The core community this app serves!
